# Trilinear interpolation for Array{Point3f, 3}
# Returns interpolated Point3f directly
@inbounds function interpolated_getindex(data_3d::Array{Point3f, 3}, ranges, point::Point3f)
    # Extract range parameters as Point3f for vectorized operations
    range_first = Point3f(first.(ranges))
    range_step = Point3f(step.(ranges))
    grid_size = Point3f(size(data_3d))

    # Map coordinates to grid indices (vectorized)
    idx_float = (point .- range_first) ./ range_step .+ 1.0f0

    # Clamp to valid bounds
    idx_clamped = clamp.(idx_float, Point3f(1.0f0), grid_size)

    # Get integer and fractional parts
    idx_floor = floor.(idx_clamped)
    idx_frac = idx_clamped .- idx_floor

    # Convert to integer indices and clamp for array access
    idx = unsafe_trunc.(Int, idx_floor)
    idx = clamp.(idx, 1, unsafe_trunc.(Int, grid_size .- 1.0f0))

# Trilinear interpolation for Array{Point3f, 3}
# Returns interpolated Point3f directly
@inbounds function interpolated_getindex(data_3d::Array{Point3f, 3}, grid_start::Point3f, grid_step::Point3f, point::Point3f)
    # Grid size as Point3f
    grid_size = Point3f(size(data_3d))

    # Map coordinates to grid indices (vectorized)
    idx_float = (point .- grid_start) ./ grid_step .+ 1.0f0

    # Clamp to valid bounds
    idx_clamped = clamp.(idx_float, Point3f(1.0f0), grid_size)

    # Get integer and fractional parts
    idx_floor = floor.(idx_clamped)
    idx_frac = idx_clamped .- idx_floor

    # Convert to integer indices and clamp for array access
    idx = unsafe_trunc.(Int, idx_floor)
    idx = clamp.(idx, 1, unsafe_trunc.(Int, grid_size .- 1.0f0))
